mechanism.proposal_pool: Unchanged GroundingDINO objects prompt over full frame plus four fixed 40-percent corner tiles, capped at 48 proposals without truth filtering.
mechanism.masker: Unchanged SAM2.1 small mask per retained proposal.
mechanism.association: Lift query masks through registered depth and pose; on both consecutive-frame edges use symmetric depth-consistent coverage, then rank depth support, mutual-best support, maximum track score, objectness, and frozen proposal index.

gate.success_unit: A frame succeeds when any of the first three geometry-ranked proposals has IoU at least 0.8 with the target region.
gate.equivalence_rationale: The bounded hypothesis set is responsible for preserving a task-usable target region, not for selecting one exact maximum-IoU member among overlapping duplicate proposals. The 0.8 threshold requires strong localization and is frozen on queue row 3 before source acquisition.

comparison.baseline: Objectness-only Top-3 target-region coverage under the identical proposal pool.
report: objectness Top-3 coverage frames at IoU>=0.8
frames improved or regressed against objectness

fallback_action: Seal a negative without tuning on queue row 3; diagnose whether failure is proposal opportunity, depth support, association ambiguity, or target-instance selection before changing information source.
claim_boundary: This gate evaluates only bounded proposal-set coverage of the annotated target region on one new physical-door family. It does not identify target ownership or establish portal access, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, reliability, or safety.
